app.name: HIVECAST
app.errorTitle: Something went wrong in the interface
app.errorBody: Reload to keep using HIVECAST. The details were written to the log for troubleshooting.

media.emptyBody: Add a room on Monitor; finished recordings will appear here automatically.
media.noFile: The file is gone; only the record can be deleted
media.noMatchBody: Try another keyword, or switch the platform filter back to All.
media.mergeHint: Select at least two recordings to merge

hosts.emptyBody: Hosts show up here after their first finished recording.
hosts.goneBody: The recordings may have been deleted or removed.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: Recording, post-processing, merges, and exports queue here; the latest 100 finished tasks are kept.
tasks.emptyRunningHint: Recording, remuxing, or merging will show up here automatically.
tasks.emptyHistoryHint: Finished tasks keep their status and timing here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.recordQuality: Default record quality for new rooms
settings.viewQuality: Default view quality for new rooms
settings.maxConcurrentHint: New recordings are refused past the limit; running ones are untouched.
settings.retentionHint: 0 disables a rule. With both set, expired days go first, then the oldest recordings until the cap fits. Videos and their danmaku files are removed together.
settings.notify: Send a system notification when recording starts or stops
settings.postModeHint: Keep the live source container first, then choose whether to remux or run a custom command. The source moves to the trash only after the output is verified and the database commit succeeds.
settings.postModeSourceDesc: Save the live source format as-is. No extra processing, best compatibility.
settings.postModeConvertDesc: Container-only remux with no re-encoding. Keep the original quality and optionally delete the source.
settings.postModeCustomDesc: Run a full ffmpeg argument template after recording. The source is never deleted automatically.
settings.postConvertFormatHint: Container-only remux with -c copy. No re-encoding, so quality is unchanged and HEVC/AV1 stay as they are.
settings.postDeleteSource: Move the source to the trash
settings.postDeleteSourceHint: Only available in remux mode. The source is moved to the system trash after the output passes validation and the database commit.
settings.postCustomCommandHint: Full ffmpeg argument template. Must contain {input} and {output}. Runs without a shell, so pipes and redirects are rejected. The source is never deleted automatically.
settings.postCustomOutputExtHint: Letters and digits only, up to 8 characters.
settings.postCustomTimeoutHint: Stop the custom command after this many seconds. Allowed range: 10 seconds to 24 hours.
settings.aboutHint: Icons and interface assets are original HIVECAST designs.
settings.trayHint: Closing the window keeps HIVECAST in the tray so recordings continue
settings.pageAccountDesc: Sign in to each platform; recording and playback use these credentials
settings.pageRecordDesc: Default quality for new rooms and how many record at once
settings.pageDanmakuDesc: Choose which danmaku events recordings keep
settings.pageStorageDesc: Where recordings live and how long they stay
settings.pageNotifyDesc: Choose which events raise a system notification
settings.sectionDanmakuDesc: Changes apply to recordings started afterwards; the current session keeps its settings. Live danmaku in the watch page is unaffected.
settings.danmakuRecordHint: When off, no JSONL is created and no ASS subtitle is exported.
settings.sectionDanmakuEventsDesc: Chat is always kept; gifts include free gifts and combo gifts.
settings.danmakuGiftHint: Supported on all four connected platforms.
settings.danmakuSuperChatHint: Bilibili only; when off, Super Chats are not written to recordings.
settings.danmakuGuardHint: Bilibili only; v1 records new guard purchases only, not renewals.
settings.danmakuChatAlways: Chat is always recorded and has no switch.
settings.searchEmptyHint: Try a platform, quality, notification, or folder
settings.sectionStreamDesc: Quality is matched first, then codec and source format; if nothing matches, it falls back to an available stream.
settings.sectionSplitDesc: Recording never stops; files are cut at segment boundaries and the session stays grouped as one live.
settings.sourceFormatHint: Prefer this source format; fall back automatically when the platform does not offer it.
settings.recordCodecHint: Prefer this codec; recording still works when the platform only offers another codec.
settings.splitOnTitleHint: When the live title changes, cut a new clip at the nearest segment boundary.
settings.splitMaxDurationHint: Cut a clip when it reaches this duration. 0 disables it; the minimum is 60 s, and 1–59 is saved as 60.
settings.splitMaxSizeHint: Cut a clip as it approaches this size. 0 disables it; the minimum is 64 MB, and 1–63 MB is saved as 64 MB.
settings.logDirHint: Leave empty to use the platform default. Logs roll daily and continue into a new 16 MiB segment with no daily total cap. Log usage is not counted toward the media library limit.
settings.logDropped: {{n}} log chunks were dropped because the queue was full or the write failed (write batches, not lines)
settings.logRetentionHint: Older logs are cleaned at startup, when settings are saved, and by the daily sweep. 0 disables the daily cleanup.
settings.trashTitle: Deleted files go to the recycle bin first
settings.trashHint: Deleting the source master or a whole recording moves files to the system recycle bin; removing the record does not free disk space immediately.
settings.trashRestoreYes: Files can be restored directly from the system recycle bin.
settings.trashRestoreNo: This platform only moves files to a plain folder; move them back manually.
settings.trashUnavailable: The recycle bin location is unavailable.
settings.recordQualityHint: Default for new rooms; each room can follow the global value or override it.
settings.viewQualityHint: Default quality when opening a stream
settings.mediaRootHint: Recordings are stored as platform / host / time
settings.themeHint: Dark mode uses a warm black base
settings.languageHint: Interface language; platform names stay as-is
settings.notifyRecordHint: Notify when a recording starts or finishes
settings.notifyErrorHint: Notify on stream failures, aborted recordings, and a full disk
settings.notifyAuthHint: Notify when a cookie expires and needs signing in again
settings.discardBody: Your changes will be lost when you close settings.
settings.closeActionHint: Minimizing to the tray keeps recording and monitoring running. Quitting with unfinished tasks shows a warning first.
settings.preventSleepHint: While enabled, the computer will not go to idle sleep during recording or watching.
settings.monitorIntervalHint: How often to refresh room status. Set 0 to turn automatic checks off and refresh manually.
settings.monitorBackoffHint: When a room hits rate limits or network errors, its interval grows step by step and resets after a success.
settings.monitorBackoffCapHint: Never wait longer than this between checks.
settings.filenameTemplateHint: Only the file name changes; folders still follow platform and host.
settings.filenameVars: Variables: {platform} platform · {platform_id} platform id · {host} host · {title} title · {area} area · {room_key} room · {qn} quality · {date} date · {time} time · {datetime} date and time · {year} {month} {day} {hour} {min} {sec}
settings.stripEmojiHint: Keeps emoji and arrows out of file names so they sync across devices.
settings.groupDirsHint: When off, every recording lands directly in the library root.

monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.subtitle: Add rooms to watch for going live, record automatically, and post-process.
monitor.emptyBody: Paste a room link or ID to start monitoring.
monitor.envBody: Values come from the Rust side and confirm the runtime is ready.
monitor.listBody: Recording starts when a room goes live and wraps up when it ends. The list refreshes every 15s.
monitor.inputPlaceholder: Paste a room link or ID
monitor.lineHint: Applies to the next recording and resumes
monitor.tipInput: Supports Bilibili (including b23.tv short links), Douyu, Huya, and Douyin live links or room ids.
monitor.tipAuto: Manual recording still works with auto record off. Stop sends SIGINT so ffmpeg can finalize the file.
monitor.tipQuality: Record quality is independent of playback quality. Without login platforms often downgrade; the actual quality is marked with ↓.
monitor.selectHint: Select this room for split view
monitor.addMonitorHint: When off, this room is never checked automatically and never records on its own.
monitor.addAutoRecordHint: Start recording when the room goes live.
monitor.removedKept: Room removed. Its recordings stay in the library.

watch.title: Multi-view
watch.subtitle: Up to 4 live rooms at once, with independent audio, quality, and lines.
watch.inputPlaceholder: Paste a room link or ID
watch.noCandidates: Every monitored room is already on screen, or there are no rooms yet.
watch.multiSound: 3+ streams are audible. HIVECAST never mutes automatically — use Mute all when you need silence.
watch.emptyBody: Pick a room from the monitor list or paste a link. Each tile streams independently, so switching quality never interrupts recording.
watch.hint: Watching and recording are independent sessions: changing quality or closing a tile never interrupts an active recording.
watch.degradedHint: Requested quality is unavailable; downgraded by the platform
watch.lineHint: Pick a line manually; Auto chooses the fastest
watch.dragHint: Drag a cell title onto another cell to swap them; drag a divider to resize

panel.title: Rooms
panel.dragHint: Hover a room, then pick a cell

watch.compactHint: Remove the gaps so the videos sit edge to edge
watch.fullscreenHint: Watch fullscreen (Esc to exit, F11 to toggle)

ended.title: Recording finished
ended.body: {{host}} ended the stream. The file is saved to your library

diskFull.title: Not enough disk space
diskFull.body: Recording for {{host}} was stopped. Free up space and start it again

diskLost.title: Recording folder unavailable
diskLost.body: Recording for {{host}} was stopped: the drive or folder is unavailable. Reconnect it and start again

viewFailed.title: Playback stopped
viewFailed.body: Playback for {{host}} failed after several retries: {{detail}}

qualityFallback.title: Quality lowered
qualityFallback.body: Requested quality for {{host}} is unavailable. Recording continues at quality level {{detail}}; the recording will not stop

credentialExpired.title: Session expired
credentialExpired.body: The Bilibili login for {{host}} expired. Scan the QR code again in Settings

error.ffmpegMissing: ffmpeg was not found. Install it or set its path in Settings later.

account.expiredHint: The cookie expired, so logged-in qualities fall back to guest tiers. Import it again.
account.cookiePlaceholder: Copy the Cookie request header from your browser devtools, or paste the whole line
account.cookieHint: Stored only in the local database, never uploaded.
account.qrTitle: Scan with the Bilibili mobile app
account.bilibiliHint: Signing in stores the session locally and unlocks 1080P recording.

close.title: Tasks are still running
close.body: {{n}} task(s) must finish before quitting so recordings are not damaged.
close.readyBody: It is safe to quit now.
close.autoQuitHint: Turn this on and HIVECAST will close itself once the tasks are done.
